mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.product_id, r.customer_id, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS reviewer_name FROM product_reviews r JOIN app_users u ON u.id = r.customer_id WHERE r.order_item_id = #{itemId}

SELECT r.id, r.product_id, r.customer_id, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS reviewer_name FROM product_reviews r JOIN app_users u ON u.id = r.customer_id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
